title: Preliminary Locations of Landslides and Snow Avalanches Triggered by the 2025 M7.0 Hubbard Glacier Earthquake

interpretationLabels.1: Probable large landslide or snow avalanche
interpretationLabels.2: Probable smaller landslide or snow avalanche
interpretationLabels.3: Increase in surface roughness of undetermined origin

note: The preliminary USGS inventory was interpreted from a separate Sentinel-1 comparison. Proximity is supporting context. Snow, surface moisture, and glacier motion can also change radar backscatter.
